title: Categorized Free Recall with Open-Loop Stimulation at Encoding
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial EEG recordings from neurosurgical patients performing a categorized free recall task. Participants studied lists of words drawn from semantic categories, completed arithmetic distractors, and freely recalled the words. Open-loop electrical stimulation was delivered to hippocampal and entorhinal sites during alternating two-word blocks at encoding, with stimulation parameters recorded in the event files.
methods_description: Participants studied 12-word lists (6 same-category pairs from 3 of 25 semantic categories), solved arithmetic distractor problems, then freely recalled words. In 20 of 25 lists per session, single-electrode stimulation was applied on alternating two-word blocks, starting 200 ms before the first word and lasting 4.6 s. Recordings used Blackrock or Medtronic systems, provided as monopolar and bipolar iEEG with MNI and Talairach coordinates when available.
